hooks.name: checks-after-task
hooks.description: Run lint, typecheck and tests after each spec task. Turborepo caching skips unchanged packages. The full build and packaging run once at the end of a spec, not per task.

action.command: pnpm -s turbo run lint typecheck test --output-logs=errors-only

hooks.name: checks-before-done
hooks.description: Remind the agent of the definition of done at the end of each turn.

action.prompt: If you changed code this turn, run pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck and pnpm test (the per-task hook already runs these after each spec task). If you finished a spec, also run pnpm build and pnpm package for this OS. If any fail, fix them before you say the work is done. Report which checks you ran.
